background.description: Color behind the drawing, including window interiors, the light scale-bar half, and secret-marker halos.

margin_ft.description: Empty space around the complete drawing, in map feet.

display_scale.description: Pixels per map foot at the initial display size. Enlarges the image without changing map distances.

line_color.description: Color of map symbols, the scale bar, and grid lines. The grid uses reduced opacity; text has its own color.

font_family.value: Palatino, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif
font_family.description: Font choices in preference order. Text fitting uses Palatino-based estimates, so other fonts may fit differently.

font_weight.description: Weight of all text, from 1 to 1000; 400 is normal and 700 is bold.

text_color.description: Color of room labels, key, and scale text. Secret-door markers follow the map symbols.

visible.description: Draw the SVG grid and its size note. False removes both; spacing_ft still determines stair tread spacing.

spacing_ft.description: Grid-line spacing in whole map feet. Changes the grid caption and stair tread spacing, but not room dimensions.

opacity.description: Opacity of grid lines drawn in page.line_color, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid).

stroke_ft.description: Grid-line thickness in map feet. Zero hides the lines but retains the grid-size note.

scheme.description: Must be exactly one of the case-sensitive strings "numeric" or "mnemonic". For SVG and ASCII, numeric assigns numbers from labels.start through 999 by display name; mnemonic uses unused characters from entity IDs, then A–Z and 0–9. Explicit glyphs override either scheme.

start.description: First automatic number in numeric mode, an integer from 1 to 999. Reserved numbers are skipped; explicit glyphs are unchanged. Ignored in mnemonic mode. Applies to SVG and ASCII.

ratio.description: Starting label font size as a fraction of the shorter available room dimension. labels.fit may shrink it further.

fit.description: Maximum label width as a fraction of available room width. Labels shrink to fit this limit.

columns.description: Number of SVG key columns: "auto" or a positive integer. Counts larger than the number of entries use one column per entry. Long names wrap; the image widens if needed to fit the key at the chosen font size.

visible.description: Draw the SVG room key independently of room labels and the scale annotation.

font_ft.description: Room-key font size in map feet, used for identifiers and names. Affects wrapping and columns.

identifier_gap_ft.description: Horizontal gap between identifiers and names in the room key, in map feet.

column_gap_ft.description: Horizontal gap between key columns, in map feet. Wider gaps may result in fewer columns.

line_spacing_ft.description: Vertical distance between successive key text lines, in map feet. Must be at least key.font_ft.

visible.description: Draw the SVG scale bar, distance labels, and (when grid.visible is true) grid-size note, independently of the key.

length_ft.description: Scale bar length in map feet. Text matches the key; bar thickness and label spacing scale with that text size.

gap_ft.description: Vertical spacing in feet: lowest room edge to scale rectangle’s lower edge, and grid-note baseline to first key-row baseline. A baseline is the line letters sit on.

interior_stroke_ft.description: Thickness of interior walls, stair edges, and open-door dots, in map feet.

exterior_stroke_ft.description: Thickness of exposed outer walls, in map feet; shared walls use walls.interior_stroke_ft.

stroke_ft.description: Thickness of solid and secret door bars, in map feet; opening widths stay unchanged.

open_dash.description: Alternating mark and gap lengths for open-door dots, in map feet. Default: 0.01-ft marks, 1.5-ft gaps.

secret_font_ft.description: Font size of secret-door S markers, in map feet.

secret_halo_ft.description: Thickness of the background-colored outline separating each secret-door S from its door bar, in feet.

gap_ft.description: Distance between the centers of a window’s two lines, in feet; clear space is smaller by windows.stroke_ft.

stroke_ft.description: Thickness of each window line, in map feet.

treads_per_grid.description: Stair tread intervals per grid square; 3 with a 5-ft grid gives roughly 1.67-ft spacing.

stroke_ft.description: Stair tread-line thickness in map feet. Side edges use walls.interior_stroke_ft.

max_ratio.description: Tread length at the high end of stairs, as a fraction of the space between side edges.

min_ratio.description: Tread length at the downhill end, as a fraction of the space between side edges. Cannot exceed stairs.max_ratio.

stroke_ft.description: Thickness of dashed internal block dividers, in map feet.

dash.description: Alternating divider dash and gap lengths, in map feet. Default: 1.5-ft dashes, 1-ft gaps.
